name: Gavel of Light's self-heal coefficient matches its own tooltip's 50% (#9036)
contract: Gavel of Light 800611's tooltip reads 'Smash an enemy for $s2% Weapon Damage plus ${$m1+0)} and heal yourself equal to $707521s1% of the damage dealt.' sun_cleric_spells::OnSpellHitResult (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp) computes the self-heal as CalculatePct(damage, Amount(707521)), where Amount() (AscensionSunCleric.cpp) returns info->Effects[slot].CalcValue(caster) for 707521 unmodified by any SpellMod. Spell.dbc gives 707521 EffectBasePoints[0] 49 and EffectDieSides[0] 1; SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp) adds +1 for DieSides 1, so CalcValue() resolves to exactly 50 -- the same 50% the tooltip names, with no separate coefficient applied anywhere else (Arbiter of Light 302914's SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 on 707521 is inert here because Amount() never calls ApplySpellMod; a separate concern already covered by sun-cleric-arbiter-of-light.json). This scenario pins that same spell_effect_value path -- the exact value Amount(707521) reads at cast time -- to 50, and confirms the self-heal is live-wired by observing that casting Gavel of Light actually produces at least one 707522 heal on the caster, so the formula is not dead code. The reporter's '~20%' estimate was an unverified in-game impression with no combat-log excerpt (#9036 investigation); no code path was found applying any percentage other than this one.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
DISCRIMINATING: Amount(707521) resolves to the tooltip's 50%, not a lower value
Test Polearm in the main hand
The self-heal formula is live-wired, not dead code
